param.name: idletime
param.comment: Time to wait when no station needs an update.

param.name: maxrange
param.default: if @this.ship.pilot.skill.piloting ge 15 then 5 else if @this.ship.pilot.skill.piloting ge 12 then 4 else if @this.ship.pilot.skill.piloting ge 9 then 3 else if @this.ship.pilot.skill.piloting ge 6 then 2 else 1
param.comment: Maximum number of gate jumps allowed by the pilot's Piloting skill.

input_param.name: max
input_param.value: if @this.ship.pilot.skill.piloting ge 15 then 5 else if @this.ship.pilot.skill.piloting ge 12 then 4 else if @this.ship.pilot.skill.piloting ge 9 then 3 else if @this.ship.pilot.skill.piloting ge 6 then 2 else 1

param.name: useparking
param.comment: Return to a selected sector when no station needs an update.

param.name: parkingsector
param.comment: Sector used when Parking sector is enabled.

param.name: proactive
param.comment: Visit the least recently refreshed temporary subscription in the current sector instead of idling.

set_value.name: $skillrange
set_value.exact: if @$ship.pilot.skill.piloting ge 15 then 5 else if @$ship.pilot.skill.piloting ge 12 then 4 else if @$ship.pilot.skill.piloting ge 9 then 3 else if @$ship.pilot.skill.piloting ge 6 then 2 else 1

param.name: xpfactor
